title: Adjustment of Booked Medical Claims
content:
An adjustment to a medical claim already booked on a Medicaid Managed Care Membership is an entry that reverses member cost share previously booked on an original claim.

## Clauses in force

**A1. Paid originals only.** Only an original claim whose adjudication status is paid can be adjusted. The status is read from the claim ledger for the claim number of the original claim.

**A2. Adjustment window.** The adjustment is booked no later than the category's claim adjustment window days after the original claim's booked date. The window is counted in calendar days from the day after the booked date, and the last day of the window still qualifies. The booked date is read from the claim ledger for the original claim.

**A3. Once per original.** An original claim is adjusted at most once, so no adjustment is booked when an adjustment entry already references its claim number.

**A4. Period of the reversal.** An adjusted claim's cost share leaves the cost-sharing period of the original service date, never the current one.

## Retired clauses

Each clause below is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis.

- The clause that an adjustment reverses the whole member cost share of one original claim identified by its claim number and is booked with a new adjustment claim number whose related claim number is the original claim number.
- The clause that valid adjustment reasons are recorded as the denial code (not eligible on the service date, when coverage is found not to have been in force on the service date; duplicate claim, when the same service was booked twice; not covered, when the service is reclassified as non-covered), and that a reason outside these is not an adjustment and cannot be booked.

## Checklist before an adjustment is booked

| Point | Record read | Holds when |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | Adjudication status of the original claim | The status is paid |
| A2 | Booked date of the original claim | The booking day is on or before the last day of the window |
| A3 | Adjustment entries on the claim ledger | None already references the original claim number |

## Hypothetical boundary cases for A2

*Hypothetical dates, for a category whose claim adjustment window is 365 days.* An original claim booked on 10 March 2025 has 11 March 2025 as the first day of its window and 10 March 2026 as the last day.

- An adjustment booked on 10 March 2026 falls on the last day of the window and qualifies.
- An adjustment booked on 11 March 2026 falls one day after the window and does not qualify.

## Hypothetical case for A4

*Hypothetical.* An original claim with a service date in February is adjusted in May. The reversed cost share leaves the cost-sharing period that contains February, not the period that contains May.

superseded_clauses: An adjustment reverses the whole member cost share of one original claim identified by its claim number and is booked with a new adjustment claim number whose related_claim_number is the original claim number.

Valid adjustment reasons are recorded in denial_code: not_eligible_on_service_date when coverage is found not to have been in force on the service date, duplicate_claim when the same service was booked twice, and not_covered when the service is reclassified as non-covered; a reason outside these is not an adjustment and cannot be booked.
